rules.positive: Decode payload under the named CDDL root, encode the six-item envelope, compare canonical_hex byte-for-byte, then SHA-256 it.
rules.negative: Reject with the stable error_code before persistence or digest acceptance.
rules.normalization: AST nodes are [type, value], where type is uint, f64_bits, text_codepoints, array, map, or set; every listed input converges to expected_payload_cbor_hex.
rules.hex: Lowercase, two digits per octet, no whitespace.
rules.semantic: Apply the registry selected by field_path. Enum cases prove accepted/rejected codes; set cases normalize or reject by the named ordering, duplicate, and identity policies; idempotency cases derive only PRESENT identities from the complete persisted namespace.
